changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led Lifecycle Analyst to Growth Experiment Planner route with maturity-aware cohort evidence, pending setup and executable handoff checks.

title: Activation and Retention Intelligence
description: Compare mature SaaS signup cohorts under one activation and retention rule, then propose one owner-reviewed retention experiment without treating correlation as cause.
setup_prompt: Treat Activation and Retention Intelligence as a proposal. Inspect my signup cohorts, activation and day-30 retention rules, identity and billing sources, owner and existing Crews. Propose reuse or creation of Lifecycle Analyst and Growth Experiment Planner, exact maturity-aware artifact checks and one bounded manual run in Builder chat. Selection creates no Crew, customer contact, variant, schedule or churn prediction.

setup_inputs.label: Product, tenant, signup cohorts, activation and retention policy owner
Cohort windows, day-30 maturity cutoff, censoring and timezone
Authorized signup, product usage and subscription sources with identity joins
Eligible population, exclusions, minimum coverage and source freshness
Owner, eligible unit, primary metric, guardrail and approval route
Optional consented support or survey context
Manual only or reviewed repeat policy with timezone and budget

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create an approved missing Lifecycle or Experiment Crew with stable idempotency key and Workflow step

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated mature-cohort observation through a checked Workflow alias

recommended_tools.name: Product analytics MCP or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized signup, activation and qualifying-use events with stable account identity

recommended_tools.name: Subscription billing MCP or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify active paid state at the defined cohort maturity cutoff

recommended_tools.name: Support or survey MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Add consented qualitative context without changing cohort denominators

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether lifecycle insight explains retention and revenue outcomes
Actionability, measurement cost, and decision value
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Reviewed Lifecycle and Experiment Crew roster with source and policy map
Validated comparable, baseline-first or pending-maturity cohort observation
Exact mature observation to pending retention experiment handoff when eligible
Manual first run and paused repeat choice
